emma_support: FYI — customer (AcmeRetail) opened an escalation: invoice shows ~22% more billed tokens than their dashboard usage. They say this started after we enabled continuous batching on their Dedicated pool. Can someone triage?

devon_billing: ugh. Do we have request IDs or examples from the billing pipeline? invoice id: INV-2026-03-05-ACME

emma_support: they attached a CSV of request_ids + timestamps, sent to support@redwood. Quick sample id: rid_0a7c9fde. They report dashboard "served_tokens" = 1,200,312 but invoice shows 1,466,000 (~22% delta).

sam_rt: I'll pull logs. Which cluster/region?

emma_support: dedicated-us-west-2-acme-pool

sam_rt: grabbing traces for rid_0a7c9fde…

infra-bot: Deployed log-collector job job-logs-2026-03-10 started for pool dedicated-us-west-2-acme-pool (query id q_9c2).

sam_rt: paste of relevant snippet (redacted):
```
[1749573020] batch_id=b321 size=6 continuous_batching=on prefetched_prefix_tokens=184
[1749573020] req=rid_0a7c9fde model=redwood-7b seq_in=512 seq_out=128 model_tokens=260 prefetched=42 kv_cache_hit=false
[1749573020] req=rid_1b4d2caa model=redwood-7b seq_in=512 seq_out=64 model_tokens=224 prefetched=40 kv_cache_hit=true
[1749573020] req=rid_2c9e3f11 model=redwood-7b seq_in=512 seq_out=256 model_tokens=316 prefetched=60 kv_cache_hit=false
```

sam_rt: Note: "prefetched_prefix_tokens" logged at batch level = 184. Metering logs show per-request token counts that include those prefetched tokens for each request. That looks suspicious.

maria_prod: we have two counting systems: "metering-ingest" which consumes the normalized per-request token events (what we bill off), and "console-usage" which aggregates served tokens after cache dedupe. Historically they matched, but continuous batching added a prefetch path.

alex_sre: Wait — are we double-counting prefetched tokens across requests inside the same batch? If prefetch loads a shared prefix into the runtime, we should attribute it once, not per-request.

sam_rt: Exactly. The runtime currently sends per-request token counts to metering before batch-level post-processing dedupe. So metering_ingest sees: reqA: 160, reqB: 150, reqC: 170 (each includes the same 40-token prefetched prefix), total = 480. Console after dedupe shows unique served tokens = 360. Invoice uses metering_ingest -> shows higher number.

devon_billing: That maps to the ~22% delta customer sees. Any quick repro we can run to validate on a small scale?

sam_rt: Yes — repro steps:
1) Send three similar requests with overlapping prefixes to the same session on the dedicated pool while continuous batching is enabled.
2) Enable runtime debug: REDWOOD_RUNTIME_DEBUG=kv_metering
3) curl example:
```
curl -X POST https://dedicated.us-west-2.redwood/api/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prompt":"<shared prefix>...","max_tokens":128}'
```
Look for logs: "batch_prefetch_tokens" and per-request token events to metering queue (topic: metering.events.tokens).

maria_prod: I can reproduce on staging. I see metering.events.tokens entries with per-request prefetched counts. The console does a batch-level reduce that dedupes and shows the lower number.

emma_support: Customer asked if this is a bug or just a reporting mismatch — and if they'll be credited. What's our recommendation?

alex_sre: Root cause = metering ingestion happens before batch-level dedupe for continuous-batching + KV prefetch; thus metering counts duplicate prefix tokens once per request. It's a correctness bug in metering ordering.

devon_billing: For existing invoices — we need to quantify impact per account and propose credits. Maria, can you run a query to compute the delta per-account for the window (2026-02-25 to 2026-03-09) where continuous batching was enabled?

maria_prod: On it. Rough quick query shows AcmeRetail delta ~259k tokens (matching invoice gap). I'll run full job and produce CSV.

sam_rt: Short-term mitigation: we can flip a config on the runtime to stop sending per-request prefetched counts to metering, and instead emit batch-level deduped counts. Flag: runtime:emit_metering_after_batch=true. Rolling that out to Acme pool now as a patch (will be non-disruptive but needs careful coordination with billing pipeline).

infra-bot: Patch rollout started: runtime-metering-fix v0.12 -> dedicated-us-west-2-acme-pool (canary 1/4).

devon_billing: Long-term fix: update metering-ingest to accept batch_id and de-duplicate prefetched tokens across requests in a batch if they share the same prefetch checksum. Also add unit tests + integration test using our sim-tool. Prioritize for next sprint.

emma_support: Communicating to customer: propose credit for the delta and timeline: patch applied to their pool (ETA 30m for full roll), billing job will re-run reconciliation for the affected invoices and we’ll propose a credit if the reconciliation confirms. Is that OK?

devon_billing: Yes — offer credit for the delta and follow up with post-mortem. Also create a billing alert if metered > console by >5% for any account over a day.

alex_sre: Note for docs: add a KB explaining how continuous batching + KV prefetch interacts with metering and what flags are available to force strict accounting.

maria_prod: Reconciliation job finished: CSV attached to the ticket (s3://internal/support/acme/deltas.csv). delta = 259,688 tokens -> credit of $32.46 (per pricing table).

emma_support: Great — I'll send an email to the customer with the fix summary, credit, and steps they can take (disable continuous batching or keep it on with corrected accounting). Will paste proposed email here shortly. :thumbsup:

sam_rt: Follow-up: opened GH issue redwood/metering#987 "dedupe-prefetch-tokens-in-metering-ingest" with repro and logs.

emma_support: Closing loop: set customer status to "credit-issued" and schedule postmortem doc. Thanks team.

devon_billing: Marking for finance review.

emma_support: END OF THREAD (internal notes archived to ticket TKT-15432).
